description: This file contains an aiohttp-based HTTP client implementation with custom response and session classes, including request info obfuscation and utility functions for user agent and sensitive data handling.

classes.name: ClientResponse
classes.description: Custom response class that obfuscates request info and handles JSON responses.

classes.name: ClientSession
classes.description: Custom session class that manages HTTP requests with default headers, automatic decompression, and response handling.

methods.name: obfuscate
methods.description: Obfuscates sensitive query parameters based on regex matching.

methods.name: get_user_agent
methods.description: Returns a semi-random user agent string from a predefined list.
